title: Under the crossing, a May morning now (speculative)
statement: A speculative montage, not a recording: no one has recorded at the crossing since the breach. The line is synthesized (Ferosplavna-1, 330 kV, the one line connected since 24 March 2026, voiced as the Hum voices it, its crackle a little denser for a dewy morning). The birds were recorded on the drained bed about 50 km downstream and on the north bank opposite; the frog about 90 km away, since no frog has been recorded or described on the bed. Cut, high-passed at 250 Hz, levelled, panned, faded; never pitched, stretched, looped or reverberated. No sounds of fighting.
shape: the line alone, fading in over 2.5 s; the birds in from 2.0 s and out by 27.5 s; the line alone again, fading out over the last 2.5 s
level: the birds' bus peak-limited at -12 dBFS (2 ms look-ahead, 120 ms release), the whole at -20 dBFS RMS while the birds sing, peaks limited at -1 dBFS

line.name: Ferosplavna-1
line.made: hum.py's 330 kV voice (100 Hz and 11 harmonics, the 6th stressed), corona hiss and cracks at 6 a second (the Hum's 3.5), each ear its own crackle
